items.chinese: 他們都會做甜點。
items.pinyin: Tāmen dōu huì zuò tiándiǎn.
items.english: They can all make desserts.

items.chinese: 你們學校很有名。
items.pinyin: Nǐmen xuéxiào hěn yǒumíng.
items.english: Your school is very famous.

items.chinese: 請問我的手機在不在你家？
items.pinyin: Qǐngwèn wǒ de shǒujī zài bú zài nǐ jiā?
items.english: May I ask whether my mobile phone is at your home?

items.chinese: 他常常到山上去運動。
items.pinyin: Tā chángcháng dào shānshàng qù yùndòng.
items.english: He often goes to the mountains to exercise.

items.chinese: 週末你想去哪裡？
items.pinyin: Zhōumò nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
items.english: Where would you like to go this weekend?

items.chinese: 那家餐廳有一點遠，我不想去。
items.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng yǒu yìdiǎn yuǎn, wǒ bù xiǎng qù.
items.english: That restaurant is a little far away. I do not want to go.

items.chinese: 那裡有一家有名的咖啡店。
items.pinyin: Nàlǐ yǒu yì jiā yǒumíng de kāfēidiàn.
items.english: There is a famous coffee shop there.

items.chinese: 那裡的風景不錯，我們去那裡吧。
items.pinyin: Nàlǐ de fēngjǐng búcuò, wǒmen qù nàlǐ ba.
items.english: The scenery there is nice. Let’s go there.

items.chinese: 很多人都說我姐姐很美。
items.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu shuō wǒ jiějie hěn měi.
items.english: Many people say that my older sister is beautiful.

items.chinese: 那家店的前面常常有很多人。
items.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de qiánmiàn chángcháng yǒu hěn duō rén.
items.english: There are often many people in front of that store.

items.chinese: 李小姐很喜歡看海。
items.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě hěn xǐhuan kàn hǎi.
items.english: Miss Li really likes looking at the sea.

items.chinese: 你家在這家咖啡店的後面嗎？
items.pinyin: Nǐ jiā zài zhè jiā kāfēidiàn de hòumiàn ma?
items.english: Is your home behind this coffee shop?

items.chinese: 你覺得那裡的山美不美？
items.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nàlǐ de shān měi bù měi?
items.english: Do you think the mountains there are beautiful?

items.chinese: 那家店的牛肉麵真的很好吃。
items.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de niúròu miàn zhēnde hěn hǎochī.
items.english: The beef noodles at that restaurant are really delicious.

items.chinese: 我一定要去吃。
items.pinyin: Wǒ yídìng yào qù chī.
items.english: I definitely have to go eat there.

items.chinese: 你覺得這個地方怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhè ge dìfang zěnmeyàng?
items.english: What do you think of this place?

items.chinese: 你爸爸媽媽現在在家嗎？
items.pinyin: Nǐ bàba māma xiànzài zài jiā ma?
items.english: Are your father and mother at home now?

items.chinese: 他家附近的山真的很漂亮。
items.pinyin: Tā jiā fùjìn de shān zhēnde hěn piàoliang.
items.english: The mountains near his home are really beautiful.

items.chinese: 他去樓下做什麼？
items.pinyin: Tā qù lóuxià zuò shénme?
items.english: What is he going downstairs to do?

items.chinese: 你們要去哪裡？
items.pinyin: Nǐmen yào qù nǎlǐ?
items.english: Where are you going?

items.chinese: 我們要去學校找王老師。
items.pinyin: Wǒmen yào qù xuéxiào zhǎo Wáng lǎoshī.
items.english: We are going to the school to find Teacher Wang.

items.chinese: 他沒有很多朋友。
items.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu hěn duō péngyǒu.
items.english: He does not have many friends.

items.chinese: 你明天早上要去學校上課嗎？
items.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān zǎoshang yào qù xuéxiào shàngkè ma?
items.english: Are you going to school for class tomorrow morning?

items.chinese: 我朋友的家在花蓮。
items.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu de jiā zài Huālián.
items.english: My friend’s home is in Hualien.

items.chinese: 聽說你做飯做得很好，可以教我嗎？
items.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ zuòfàn zuò de hěn hǎo, kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
items.english: I heard that you cook very well. Can you teach me?

items.chinese: 我家很近，來我家喝咖啡吧！
items.pinyin: Wǒ jiā hěn jìn, lái wǒ jiā hē kāfēi ba!
items.english: My home is nearby. Come to my home for coffee!

items.chinese: 好啊。
items.pinyin: Hǎo a.
items.english: Sure.

items.chinese: 老師的家在山上，很漂亮，可是不方便。
items.pinyin: Lǎoshī de jiā zài shānshàng, hěn piàoliang, kěshì bù fāngbiàn.
items.english: The teacher’s home is in the mountains. It is beautiful, but inconvenient.

items.chinese: 這裡的風景很美，我們在這裡照相吧。
items.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng hěn měi, wǒmen zài zhèlǐ zhàoxiàng ba.
items.english: The scenery here is beautiful. Let’s take pictures here.

items.chinese: 那個學校的學生常來這家店喝咖啡、看書。
items.pinyin: Nà ge xuéxiào de xuésheng cháng lái zhè jiā diàn hē kāfēi, kànshū.
items.english: Students from that school often come to this shop to drink coffee and read.

items.chinese: 我和朋友想在那家餐廳吃飯。
items.pinyin: Wǒ hàn péngyǒu xiǎng zài nà jiā cāntīng chīfàn.
items.english: My friend and I would like to eat at that restaurant.

items.chinese: 我爸爸常做好吃的東西。
items.pinyin: Wǒ bàba cháng zuò hǎochī de dōngxi.
items.english: My father often makes delicious food.

items.chinese: 你哥哥在圖書館外面做什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ gēge zài túshūguǎn wàimiàn zuò shénme?
items.english: What is your older brother doing outside the library?

items.chinese: 這家牛肉麵店外面不好看，可是裡面很漂亮。
items.pinyin: Zhè jiā niúròu miàn diàn wàimiàn bù hǎokàn, kěshì lǐmiàn hěn piàoliang.
items.english: This beef noodle shop does not look nice outside, but it is beautiful inside.

items.chinese: 那家商店的東西很多也不貴，我朋友常去那裡買東西。
items.pinyin: Nà jiā shāngdiàn de dōngxi hěn duō yě bú guì, wǒ péngyǒu cháng qù nàlǐ mǎi dōngxi.
items.english: That store has many things and they are not expensive. My friend often goes there to shop.

items.chinese: 我家附近有很多餐廳，吃飯很方便，所以我不常自己做飯。
items.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu hěn duō cāntīng, chīfàn hěn fāngbiàn, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng zìjǐ zuòfàn.
items.english: There are many restaurants near my home, so eating is convenient and I do not often cook for myself.

items.chinese: 我覺得你們的宿舍很新也很漂亮。
items.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐmen de sùshè hěn xīn yě hěn piàoliang.
items.english: I think your dormitory is very new and beautiful.

items.chinese: 那家商店在二樓，不是在一樓。
items.pinyin: Nà jiā shāngdiàn zài èr lóu, bú shì zài yì lóu.
items.english: That store is on the second floor, not the first floor.

items.chinese: 張小姐想在那棟大樓的前面照相。
items.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě xiǎng zài nà dòng dàlóu de qiánmiàn zhàoxiàng.
items.english: Miss Zhang wants to take a picture in front of that building.

items.chinese: 他家在這棟大樓的四樓。
items.pinyin: Tā jiā zài zhè dòng dàlóu de sì lóu.
items.english: His home is on the fourth floor of this building.

items.chinese: 聽說那個圖書館很美，我想去看看。
items.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà ge túshūguǎn hěn měi, wǒ xiǎng qù kànkan.
items.english: I heard that library is beautiful. I would like to go and see it.

items.chinese: 你們宿舍旁邊那家店的小籠包怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Nǐmen sùshè pángbiān nà jiā diàn de xiǎolóngbāo zěnmeyàng?
items.english: How are the soup dumplings at the shop beside your dormitory?

items.chinese: 我們現在要去教室上課。
items.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài yào qù jiàoshì shàngkè.
items.english: We are going to the classroom for class now.

items.chinese: 那個游泳池常有很多人，所以我們不常去那裡游泳。
items.pinyin: Nà ge yóuyǒngchí cháng yǒu hěn duō rén, suǒyǐ wǒmen bù cháng qù nàlǐ yóuyǒng.
items.english: That swimming pool is often crowded, so we do not often go swimming there.

items.chinese: 他們明天早上十點要去打籃球。
items.pinyin: Tāmen míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn yào qù dǎ lánqiú.
items.english: They are going to play basketball at ten tomorrow morning.

items.chinese: 臺灣有很多KTV，在那裡可以唱歌，也可以吃東西。
items.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu hěn duō KTV, zài nàlǐ kěyǐ chànggē, yě kěyǐ chī dōngxi.
items.english: There are many KTVs in Taiwan. You can sing and also eat there.

items.chinese: 我媽媽很喜歡唱歌。陳月美常唱中文歌。
items.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn xǐhuan chànggē. Chén Yuèměi cháng chàng Zhōngwén gē.
items.english: My mother really likes singing. Chen Yuemei often sings Chinese songs.

items.chinese: 我早上八點十分上課。
items.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang bā diǎn shí fēn shàngkè.
items.english: My class starts at 8:10 in the morning.

items.chinese: 明天我們幾點見面？
items.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen jǐ diǎn jiànmiàn?
items.english: What time will we meet tomorrow?

items.chinese: 晚上六點。
items.pinyin: Wǎnshang liù diǎn.
items.english: At six in the evening.

items.chinese: 田中從他們宿舍到圖書館去看書。
items.pinyin: Tiánzhōng cóng tāmen sùshè dào túshūguǎn qù kànshū.
items.english: Tianzhong goes from their dormitory to the library to read.

items.chinese: 月美和安同今天中午一起在學校餐廳吃飯。
items.pinyin: Yuèměi hàn Āntóng jīntiān zhōngwǔ yìqǐ zài xuéxiào cāntīng chīfàn.
items.english: Yuemei and Antong are eating together in the school restaurant at noon today.

items.chinese: 這個週末，我得在家做飯。
items.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò, wǒ děi zài jiā zuòfàn.
items.english: This weekend, I have to cook at home.

items.chinese: 我們學校後面有一家銀行。
items.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào hòumiàn yǒu yì jiā yínháng.
items.english: There is a bank behind our school.

items.chinese: 你明天什麼時候去銀行？
items.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān shénme shíhou qù yínháng?
items.english: When are you going to the bank tomorrow?

items.chinese: 早上十一點。
items.pinyin: Zǎoshang shíyī diǎn.
items.english: At eleven in the morning.

items.chinese: 我後天晚上想去看電影。
items.pinyin: Wǒ hòutiān wǎnshang xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng.
items.english: I want to go see a movie the evening after tomorrow.

items.chinese: 我和朋友常去大安圖書館看書。
items.pinyin: Wǒ hàn péngyǒu cháng qù Dà’ān túshūguǎn kànshū.
items.english: My friend and I often go to the Daan Library to read.

items.chinese: 下次你想什麼時候來臺灣？
items.pinyin: Xià cì nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhou lái Táiwān?
items.english: When would you like to come to Taiwan next time?

items.chinese: 我們週末要去KTV唱歌，你一定要來。
items.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò yào qù KTV chànggē, nǐ yídìng yào lái.
items.english: We are going to sing at KTV this weekend. You must come.

items.chinese: 沒問題。
items.pinyin: Méi wèntí.
items.english: No problem.

items.chinese: 我哥哥昨天來臺灣找我。
items.pinyin: Wǒ gēge zuótiān lái Táiwān zhǎo wǒ.
items.english: My older brother came to Taiwan to see me yesterday.

items.chinese: 真好。對了，他想學中文嗎？
items.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo. Duì le, tā xiǎng xué Zhōngwén ma?
items.english: That is great. By the way, does he want to learn Chinese?

items.chinese: 你什麼時候有空？我們去吃越南菜。
items.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou yǒu kòng? Wǒmen qù chī Yuènán cài.
items.english: When are you free? Let’s go eat Vietnamese food.

items.chinese: 我後天中午有空。
items.pinyin: Wǒ hòutiān zhōngwǔ yǒu kòng.
items.english: I am free at noon the day after tomorrow.

items.chinese: 明天早上九點我們去打網球，怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn wǒmen qù dǎ wǎngqiú, zěnmeyàng?
items.english: How about playing tennis at nine tomorrow morning?

items.chinese: 沒問題，再見。
items.pinyin: Méi wèntí, zàijiàn.
items.english: No problem. Goodbye.

items.chinese: 你是哪國人？你現在在臺灣的家在哪裡？
items.pinyin: Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Nǐ xiànzài zài Táiwān de jiā zài nǎlǐ?
items.english: Which country are you from? Where is your current home in Taiwan?

items.chinese: 你家前面有什麼？後面呢？
items.pinyin: Nǐ jiā qiánmiàn yǒu shénme? Hòumiàn ne?
items.english: What is in front of your home? What about behind it?

items.chinese: 從你家到學校遠不遠？方便不方便？
items.pinyin: Cóng nǐ jiā dào xuéxiào yuǎn bù yuǎn? Fāngbiàn bù fāngbiàn?
items.english: Is it far from your home to school? Is it convenient?

items.chinese: 你家附近有咖啡店嗎？那家店在哪裡？
items.pinyin: Nǐ jiā fùjìn yǒu kāfēidiàn ma? Nà jiā diàn zài nǎlǐ?
items.english: Is there a coffee shop near your home? Where is that shop?

items.chinese: 你常幾點到咖啡店去？在那裡做什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ cháng jǐ diǎn dào kāfēidiàn qù? Zài nàlǐ zuò shénme?
items.english: What time do you usually go to the coffee shop? What do you do there?

items.chinese: 你中午常幾點吃飯？在哪裡吃？
items.pinyin: Nǐ zhōngwǔ cháng jǐ diǎn chīfàn? Zài nǎlǐ chī?
items.english: What time do you usually eat lunch? Where do you eat?

items.chinese: 那家餐廳的什麼最好吃？一碗或一個多少錢？
items.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de shénme zuì hǎochī? Yì wǎn huò yí ge duōshao qián?
items.english: What is the most delicious thing at that restaurant? How much is one bowl or one item?

items.chinese: 你週末從幾點到幾點有空？有空的時候喜歡做什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ zhōumò cóng jǐ diǎn dào jǐ diǎn yǒu kòng? Yǒu kòng de shíhou xǐhuan zuò shénme?
items.english: From what time until what time are you free on weekends? What do you like doing when you are free?

items.chinese: 我們的教室在幾樓？教室外面有什麼？
items.pinyin: Wǒmen de jiàoshì zài jǐ lóu? Jiàoshì wàimiàn yǒu shénme?
items.english: Which floor is our classroom on? What is outside the classroom?

items.chinese: 學校的圖書館在哪裡？旁邊有什麼？
items.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zài nǎlǐ? Pángbiān yǒu shénme?
items.english: Where is the school library? What is beside it?

items.chinese: 你今天從幾點到幾點上中文課？在哪裡上課？
items.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān cóng jǐ diǎn dào jǐ diǎn shàng Zhōngwén kè? Zài nǎlǐ shàngkè?
items.english: From what time until what time do you have Chinese class today? Where do you have class?

items.chinese: 你喜歡在學校做什麼？常什麼時候做？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan zài xuéxiào zuò shénme? Cháng shénme shíhou zuò?
items.english: What do you like doing at school? When do you usually do it?

items.chinese: 你常到哪家商店買東西？那家店在哪裡？
items.pinyin: Nǐ cháng dào nǎ jiā shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi? Nà jiā diàn zài nǎlǐ?
items.english: Which store do you often go to for shopping? Where is that store?

items.chinese: 你喜歡唱歌嗎？會不會唱中文歌？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan chànggē ma? Huì bú huì chàng Zhōngwén gē?
items.english: Do you like singing? Can you sing Chinese songs?

items.chinese: 你明天晚上有空嗎？想不想一起到學校附近吃飯？
items.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān wǎnshang yǒu kòng ma? Xiǎng bù xiǎng yìqǐ dào xuéxiào fùjìn chīfàn?
items.english: Are you free tomorrow evening? Would you like to eat together near the school?

items.chinese: 你後天什麼時候有空？想去哪裡？我們幾點在哪裡見面？
items.pinyin: Nǐ hòutiān shénme shíhou yǒu kòng? Xiǎng qù nǎlǐ? Wǒmen jǐ diǎn zài nǎlǐ jiànmiàn?
items.english: When are you free the day after tomorrow? Where would you like to go? What time and where should we meet?

items.chinese: 你想買一本書，要到哪裡買？那個地方在學校裡面還是外面？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng mǎi yì běn shū, yào dào nǎlǐ mǎi? Nà ge dìfang zài xuéxiào lǐmiàn háishi wàimiàn?
items.english: You want to buy a book. Where should you go to buy it? Is that place inside or outside the school?

items.chinese: 你不想在宿舍吃飯，想到哪裡吃？那家餐廳的旁邊有什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng zài sùshè chīfàn, xiǎng dào nǎlǐ chī? Nà jiā cāntīng de pángbiān yǒu shénme?
items.english: You do not want to eat in the dormitory. Where would you like to eat? What is beside that restaurant?

items.chinese: 學校的游泳池在哪裡？附近有沒有商店或餐廳？
items.pinyin: Xuéxiào de yóuyǒngchí zài nǎlǐ? Fùjìn yǒu méiyǒu shāngdiàn huò cāntīng?
items.english: Where is the school swimming pool? Are there any stores or restaurants nearby?

items.chinese: 朋友到學校找你，你想在哪裡和他見面？為什麼？
items.pinyin: Péngyǒu dào xuéxiào zhǎo nǐ, nǐ xiǎng zài nǎlǐ hàn tā jiànmiàn? Wèishénme?
items.english: A friend comes to school to meet you. Where would you like to meet them? Why?

items.chinese: 你常去的商店裡面有什麼？你想在那裡買什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ cháng qù de shāngdiàn lǐmiàn yǒu shénme? Nǐ xiǎng zài nàlǐ mǎi shénme?
items.english: What is inside the store you often visit? What would you like to buy there?

items.chinese: 有個學校在山上，附近沒有商店和餐廳。你想去那裡上課嗎？為什麼？
items.pinyin: Yǒu ge xuéxiào zài shānshàng, fùjìn méiyǒu shāngdiàn hàn cāntīng. Nǐ xiǎng qù nàlǐ shàngkè ma? Wèishénme?
items.english: There is a school in the mountains with no stores or restaurants nearby. Would you like to attend class there? Why?

items.chinese: 你想在咖啡店教朋友中文，還是在家裡教？為什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zài kāfēidiàn jiāo péngyǒu Zhōngwén, háishi zài jiālǐ jiāo? Wèishénme?
items.english: Would you prefer to teach your friend Chinese in a coffee shop or at home? Why?

items.chinese: 教室裡面，老師的前面有什麼？後面有什麼？
items.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐmiàn, lǎoshī de qiánmiàn yǒu shénme? Hòumiàn yǒu shénme?
items.english: Inside the classroom, what is in front of the teacher? What is behind the teacher?

items.chinese: 朋友想看看學校的風景，你想帶他去哪個地方？那裡有什麼？
items.pinyin: Péngyǒu xiǎng kànkan xuéxiào de fēngjǐng, nǐ xiǎng dài tā qù nǎ ge dìfang? Nàlǐ yǒu shénme?
items.english: Your friend wants to see the school scenery. Where would you take them? What is there?

items.chinese: 你常去的咖啡店在大樓裡面還是外面？你覺得那裡怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Nǐ cháng qù de kāfēidiàn zài dàlóu lǐmiàn háishi wàimiàn? Nǐ juéde nàlǐ zěnmeyàng?
items.english: Is the coffee shop you often visit inside or outside a building? What do you think of that place?

items.chinese: 學校附近的餐廳，有的很有名，有的很便宜。你想去哪家吃飯？為什麼？
items.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn de cāntīng, yǒude hěn yǒumíng, yǒude hěn piányí. Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā chīfàn? Wèishénme?
items.english: Some restaurants near the school are famous, while others are inexpensive. Which one would you like to eat at? Why?

items.chinese: 你喜歡在圖書館裡面還是外面看書？為什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan zài túshūguǎn lǐmiàn háishi wàimiàn kànshū? Wèishénme?
items.english: Do you prefer reading inside or outside the library? Why?

items.chinese: 現在幾點幾分？今天的中文課幾點結束？
items.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn jǐ fēn? Jīntiān de Zhōngwén kè jǐ diǎn jiéshù?
items.english: What time is it now? What time does today’s Chinese class end?

items.chinese: 你的朋友想早上九點去KTV，你覺得怎麼樣？你想和他一起去嗎？為什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ de péngyǒu xiǎng zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn qù KTV, nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng? Nǐ xiǎng hàn tā yìqǐ qù ma? Wèishénme?
items.english: Your friend wants to go to KTV at nine in the morning. What do you think? Would you like to go together? Why?

items.chinese: 你今天四點半有空一起打球嗎？你今天得做什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān sì diǎn bàn yǒu kòng yìqǐ dǎqiú ma? Nǐ jīntiān děi zuò shénme?
items.english: Are you free to play ball together at 4:30 today? What do you have to do today?

items.chinese: 我晚上七點想和你一起吃飯，你有空嗎？你從幾點到幾點有空？
items.pinyin: Wǒ wǎnshang qī diǎn xiǎng hàn nǐ yìqǐ chīfàn, nǐ yǒu kòng ma? Nǐ cóng jǐ diǎn dào jǐ diǎn yǒu kòng?
items.english: I would like to eat with you at seven tonight. Are you free? From what time until what time are you free?

items.chinese: 你在聽音樂嗎？你想聽哪國的音樂？
items.pinyin: Nǐ zài tīng yīnyuè ma? Nǐ xiǎng tīng nǎ guó de yīnyuè?
items.english: Are you listening to music? Which country’s music would you like to hear?

items.chinese: 你每天都在家裡吃晚餐嗎？不在家吃的時候，你在哪裡吃？
items.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān dōu zài jiālǐ chī wǎncān ma? Bú zài jiā chī de shíhou, nǐ zài nǎlǐ chī?
items.english: Do you eat dinner at home every day? When you do not eat at home, where do you eat?

items.chinese: 你喜歡看籃球比賽，還是打籃球？為什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan kàn lánqiú bǐsài, háishi dǎ lánqiú? Wèishénme?
items.english: Do you prefer watching basketball games or playing basketball? Why?

items.chinese: 你每天都上中文課嗎？不上中文課的時候，你做什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān dōu shàng Zhōngwén kè ma? Bú shàng Zhōngwén kè de shíhou, nǐ zuò shénme?
items.english: Do you attend Chinese class every day? What do you do when you do not have Chinese class?

items.chinese: 你會唱哪國的歌？唱得怎麼樣？你想學唱哪國的歌？
items.pinyin: Nǐ huì chàng nǎ guó de gē? Chàng de zěnmeyàng? Nǐ xiǎng xué chàng nǎ guó de gē?
items.english: Which country’s songs can you sing? How well do you sing them? Which country’s songs would you like to learn?

items.chinese: 你晚上常從幾點到幾點上網？在家裡還是在圖書館？
items.pinyin: Nǐ wǎnshang cháng cóng jǐ diǎn dào jǐ diǎn shàngwǎng? Zài jiālǐ háishi zài túshūguǎn?
items.english: From what time until what time do you usually use the internet at night? At home or in the library?

items.chinese: 你可以在圖書館裡面喝咖啡嗎？你想在哪裡喝咖啡？
items.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài túshūguǎn lǐmiàn hē kāfēi ma? Nǐ xiǎng zài nǎlǐ hē kāfēi?
items.english: May you drink coffee inside the library? Where would you like to drink coffee?

items.chinese: 你想學書法嗎？想什麼時候學？在哪裡學？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng xué shūfǎ ma? Xiǎng shénme shíhou xué? Zài nǎlǐ xué?
items.english: Would you like to learn calligraphy? When would you like to learn it? Where would you study it?
